input.body:
label: question
file: none

Answered by the architecture docs: after a successful import the worker deletes the uploaded file from object storage; only the parsed transactions are kept in Postgres. Uploads that fail to import are retained for 7 days (so the original file can be inspected) and then removed by an hourly purge job. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, section "What happens to uploaded files". No code change needed.
